title: Phase 3 API helper boundary cleanup
summary: Phase 3 removes core API helper imports from desktop API/dialog helpers and moves Local API route contract consumption to contracts-owned modules while preserving desktop compatibility exports.
reason: GitHub #23 needs the API helper boundary cleaned before later DTO/model slices can proceed without core.api depending on desktop adapters.
behavior_before: core.api command helpers imported desktop API path-dialog and queue-source-path shims as fallbacks; core telemetry imported the Local API route contract from desktop.api.contract.
behavior_after: core.api command helpers use core-owned validation/selection helpers and injected picker adapters; LocalApiServer injects the desktop-owned Windows picker; core telemetry imports the route contract from mediapipeline.contracts.api_routes. Route names, command names, command journal behavior, strict confirmations, and WebView dispatch remain unchanged.
manual_validation: py_compile on touched API, contracts, telemetry, rename, and desktop server modules: passed
